method_definition: HybridPPO + feasibility-aware energy-continuation SOC lower bound + optimistic time-feasibility SOC upper bound + one global TRAIN-only return scale

checkpoint_selection.secondary: minimize parent-balanced validation all-routes completion time

training_matrix.note: The 20 runs already completed at training_execution_sha before this protocol file. They are frozen, not rerun.

legacy_evrptwgr_challenge.role: legacy same-domain challenge, not a fresh TEST

primary_metrics: failure-retaining completion time (feasible: actual completion; infeasible: depot due date H)

statistics.learned_summary: mean and SD across the five training seeds
statistics.uncertainty: 95 percent hierarchical bootstrap, resampling training seed then base_instance
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm within that two-comparison primary family
statistics.baselines: secondary reference family, not used for method selection

failure_handling.training_failure_return: G_failure = -(H - t0) - L_remaining, not simply -H. Successful training return is -T_completion. This protocol does not change the reward.
